svg.title: Residents open a corridor around the billboard for the evidence van.
svg.desc: People move carts and bicycles aside to create a route through Junction Square. Babul-da steers around the smart billboard support that still blocks one lane, while Riju runs beside the evidence and Cecil rides on the cargo bed.
svg.text: Page 51, panel 4 · Long view through Junction Square's obstructed lane
